title: Glass Pastry Display and Register Counter
description: One static bakery selling-counter scene combining one complete original open worktable, one complete original two-tier physical-glass bakery display case, one whole original plated rolled croissant on its upper shelf and one complete original fixed-open register. All four old asset IDs preserve original local POSITION/NORMAL payloads, entire constant PBR materials including the exact transmission/IOR extensions, and internal hierarchies. Only whole-instance translations and one finite floor are new; no new independent props, recoloured food or copied pastry count. The complete case and register footprints fit on the actual finite table top with a positive complete-bounds gap, and the complete original plated pastry fits on the upper shelf with space to the case ceiling. Offline Blender glass appearance is inspected in the actual renders; CPU sampling grain and real-time WebGL transmission/depth ordering remain limitations. Static appearance only: no cashier/payment, replenishment path, door motion, food safety, service operation, load or structural safety claim.
